entities.summary: Erkin Adylbek Uulu is a Kyrgyzstani boxer. He is 1.9m tall (6'3ft). He competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics in the men's light heavyweight event, in which he was eliminated in the round of 32 by Juan Carlos Carrillo. He was the flag bearer for Kyrgyzstan at the Parade of Nations.
